items.source: An ObservationHandler that can wrap another one and makes the tracing data available for the ObservationHandler.onStop(Observation.Context) method. This handler can be used in cases where the logging library or needs access to the tracing data (i.e.: log correlation).
items.translation: 一个能够包装另一个处理器的ObservationHandler，它使得追踪数据在ObservationHandler.onStop(Observation.Context)方法中可用。此处理器可用于日志库需要访问追踪数据的场景（例如：日志关联）。
